message: Last week, we had a surprise blackout that left the whole neighborhood in darkness. I was a bit nervous at first, but then I remembered my trusty flashlights and power banks all charged up and ready. As I gathered my family around, we shared stories and enjoyed some snacks from the fridge before they got too warm. It felt great to finally be the prepared one for once! Have you ever had a moment where your planning paid off during an unexpected situation?
